english.title: Deliver a false / misleading document to obtain the whole / part of a guarantee section of a fund

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: common agricultural policy protection of community arrangements regulations 1992

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly or recklessly delivered a document, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT..),

(A)_[for the purpose of obtaining for yourself or another person, the whole or a part of a sum financed by or for the account of the Guarantee Section of the European Agricultural Guidance and Guarantee Fund,]_
(B)_[for the purposes of evading payment of the whole or a part of a sum financed by or for the account of the Guarantee Section of the European Agricultural Guidance and Guarantee Fund for which you or another person were liable,]_
(C)_[in purported compliance with a requirement as was imposed by notice published under regulation 3 of the Common Agricultural Policy (Protection of Community Arrangements) Regulations 1992,]_

which was false or misleading in a material particular namely **(..SPECIFY MATERIAL PARTICULAR..)
english.legislation: Contrary to 8(10)(b)(iii) and (12) of the Common Agricultural Policy (Protection of Community Arrangements) Regulations 1992.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Important note to consider prior to prosecution: Regulation 4045/89 was repealed by Council Regulation (EC) No 485/2008 as of May 2008, but the Common Agricultural Policy (Protection of Community Arrangements) Regulations 1992 have not been amended.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
